# K2L Cool Aircon

> K2L Cool Aircon (K2L Cool Engineering Pte. Ltd.) is an aircon company in Singapore. We sell second-hand aircon (washed, tested, installed, with warranty) and do aircon repair, servicing, chemical overhaul and new aircon installation for HDB flats, condos, landed homes, offices and shops. Prices are quoted before work starts.

- Address: 12 Tampines North Drive 4, #08-07, Singapore 529435
- Phone and WhatsApp: +65 8712 7012
- Email: k2l.aircon.service@gmail.com
- Service area: all of Singapore
- Languages: English and Simplified Chinese

## Services

- [Second-hand aircon](https://k2lcoolaircon.com/second-hand-aircon): buy a used aircon, washed, tested and installed, with warranty
- [Aircon repair](https://k2lcoolaircon.com/aircon-repair): same-day repair for all brands when booked before 12pm
- [Aircon servicing](https://k2lcoolaircon.com/aircon-servicing): routine servicing and gas top-up
- [Chemical overhaul](https://k2lcoolaircon.com/chemical-overhaul): deep clean inside the unit for smell, weak airflow and poor cooling
- [New aircon installation](https://k2lcoolaircon.com/aircon-installation): new units supplied and installed, all major brands
- [Price list](https://k2lcoolaircon.com/pricing): current starting prices for every service
